name: Sludge
description: You spew poisonous sludge at a target creature in range. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, deal 1d10 + MOVE poison damage, and the creature must make a CON save against your Move DC or become poisoned.
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.
